_comment: Six-UAV Gazebo dev-harness run configuration. Numbers here are DEV values chosen so the harness can run; they are not competition safety parameters.
_grid_source_note: grid_source=static_substitute means: no dynamic-obstacle sensing is connected, the static map is reused as the occupancy source. This is a DEV substitute for the teammate's perception stack and must NOT ship to competition.
_limits_note: core raises CONFIG_START_OUTSIDE_TRACKING_BOUND unless position_tolerance_m <= tracking_bound_m. Spawn spacing must exceed min_separation_m + 2*tracking_bound_m or every route looks conflicting and nothing is ever granted.
_scenario_note: Scenario A: parallel lanes (8 m apart > 6 m conflict margin). Validates grant->fly->arrive->complete. Crossing lanes will be added as a separate scenario to exercise conflict handling.
_timeout_note: Gazebo runs ~2.5x real time here, so mission_timeout is wall-clock misleading.
_terminal_note: waypoint_tolerance_m must be well below arrival_tolerance_m, otherwise the executor pops the final waypoint ~1 m early and never converges.
_target_semantics: targets[].xyz is the object's GROUND position (x, y, 0). The mission point handed to the coordinator and the executor is (x, y, observation_altitude_m) -- where the UAV must hover to observe it. OPEN QUESTION for Codex: confirm that arrival tolerance is meant to be measured in 3D against this overhead point rather than against the ground position.
